sources.prompt:
Create a premium hand-painted fantasy MOBA ability icon sheet for OMOBA. EXACT 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equally sized square standalone illustrations, touching at x=50% and y=50%, no gaps, no outer margin. Reading order TOP LEFT, TOP RIGHT, BOTTOM LEFT, BOTTOM RIGHT. Each quadrant must be a separate complete game icon, NOT one continuous scene. Painterly dramatic lighting, rich material texture, sculptural large shapes, deliberate silhouettes, crisp bright focal object against very dark desaturated midnight teal background. Readable at 48px. Action vignettes, polished collectible game art, NOT thin line glyphs, NOT flat vector logos, NOT photorealism. Main subject and essential action entirely within the central 72% of its own square, corners dark and quiet to survive circular UI clipping. Different strong composition for every skill. BOTTOM LEFT: A massive sword carving a single downward diagonal blow, focused gold impact flare.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Two heavy battle axes in a violent crossing cleave with a red shockwave, brutal close-range finisher.

overrides.prompt: One single square premium painted fantasy MOBA skill icon for OMOBA, not a sheet. Dark midnight teal background, bold readable silhouette and bright focal action, rich hand-painted material texture, dramatic lighting. Main subject entirely in central 75% so a circular crop preserves it. No letters, text, labels, frames, badges, hotkeys or existing game characters. Must read clearly at 48px. LONGSHOT. A complete elegant bronze-and-wood recurved longbow seen clearly from the side, centered and floating diagonally. The full recognizable bow silhouette, taut glowing string and one long luminous ivory arrow aiming to upper right fill most of the center. Emerald aiming energy focuses at the arrowhead, a narrow receding flight trail implies tremendous range. Close-up of the weapon itself, no archer, no hands, no landscape, no distant tiny target. The BOW must dominate the icon.
